Introduction

Kevin Woo, professionally known as Kevin, is a Korean-American singer, actor, and MC affiliated with FC ENM. He began his music career as a member of the boy group XING, debuting on December 14, 2006, with the single album In Your Hands. Kevin departed from the group in April 2008 and subsequently filed a successful lawsuit against XING Entertainment over contractual issues, which he won in March 2010. Later that year, he joined U-KISS and officially debuted with the group on August 28, 2008, through their mini album New Generation. He remained an active member until March 2017, when he announced his departure upon the expiration of his contract. He was also part of U-KISS's subunit, uBEAT.

Following his departure from U-KISS, Kevin pursued a solo career. He made his Japanese solo debut with the single "Ride Along" on October 25, 2018, and later launched his U.S. solo career with the release of "Got It" on June 29, 2021. Expanding into musical theatre, Kevin made his Broadway debut on April 4, 2022, in the musical KPOP, portraying Jun Hyuk, a member of the fictional idol group F8. In 2025, he lent his singing voice to the character Mystery Saja of the fictional Saja Boys in the Netflix animated film KPop Demon Hunters, marking another milestone in his multifaceted entertainment career.
